A crew member in a beige jacket holds a large black umbrella over them to provide shade. The woman smiles and laughs at the camera while the man looks ahead. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a bright, modern chapel with floor-to-ceiling glass walls overlooking a tropical outdoor setting. The woman stands facing the man, reading from a small grey booklet with focused and joyful expressions. (3) The couple stands at the altar; the man makes a gesture towards the audience, causing the woman to laugh heartily. He then takes her hand and leans in for a kiss as they stand against the glass backdrop. (4) The couple enters a banquet hall decorated with orange chairs and white floral centerpieces. Guests are seated at tables; a man with bleached blonde hair holds up a phone to record them as they walk past. (5) A man in a dark grey suit stands on a stage with a microphone in hand, gesturing with his free hand while speaking. The background shows large windows looking out onto palm trees. The guests at the tables are seen laughing and watching the speaker.
